Established in **2021 in Spring, Texas**, SreeNarthana Natyalaya is a center dedicated to excellence in Bharatanatyam, blending tradition, discipline, and artistic refinement.

Under the distinguished guidance of **Smt. Sreenandini Jayaram**, we nurture more than dancers — we nurture artists grounded in technique, expressive depth, and cultural heritage. Our training instills discipline, confidence, and devotion, shaping performers who carry the timeless spirit of Bharatanatyam with poise and authenticity.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.default: Our curriculum offers a holistic journey through Bharatanatyam, combining dance history, theory, technique, fitness, and music. Students progress through structured levels covering the full spectrum of dance education—from foundational steps to teaching and performance mastery.

fields.label: Level 1 — name
fields.default: Pādamārga — Path of the First Steps

fields.label: Level 1 — description
fields.default: Perfect for those new to Bharatanatyam, this level introduces students to the essential building blocks of the art form. Focus is on posture, coordination, rhythm, and foundational technique.

fields.label: Level 1 — what students learn (one per line)
fields.default:
Basic adavus and fundamental movements
Introduction to mudras (hand gestures)
Rhythmic training and tala awareness
Bharatanatyam's cultural & traditional context

fields.label: Level 1 — photo
fields.altDefault: Pādamārga — Path of the First Steps

fields.label: Level 2 — name
fields.default: Abhyāsa Mārga — Path of Practice and Refinement

fields.label: Level 2 — description
fields.default: Designed for students with a foundational understanding, this level deepens technique and builds expressive clarity through disciplined practice and coordination.

fields.label: Level 2 — what students learn (one per line)
fields.default:
Advanced adavus and movement combinations
Introduction to abhinaya
Strengthening rhythm through jatis and tala patterns
Coordination of body and expression
Continued repertoire exploration

fields.label: Level 2 — photo
fields.altDefault: Abhyāsa Mārga — Path of Practice and Refinement

fields.label: Level 3 — description
fields.default: This level focuses on artistic maturity and performance readiness. Students refine technique, deepen expression, and embody the art with confidence, precision, and depth.

fields.label: Level 3 — what students learn (one per line)
fields.default:
Mastery of adavus and complex sequences
Advanced abhinaya and storytelling
Rhythmic understanding and improvisation
Full dance presentations
Stage presence and musicality

fields.label: Note under the levels
fields.default: The outlined levels represent a structured approach to the method of teaching. Progression or Advancement through these levels may vary based on each student’s interest, commitment, and individual learning pace.
